title: The Great Lakes by surface area (freshwater Areas)
description: Each entry is an Area: the surface extent a lake spans, in square kilometres. Together the five lakes are the largest surface of fresh water on Earth. A real, sourced geographic area model spanning the US-Canada border.

provenance.primary_source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) — Great Lakes physical features
provenance.cross_reference: Encyclopaedia Britannica (Areas and Volumes of the Great Lakes)
provenance.note: Surface areas rounded; the combined surface is about 244,106 km2. Values are OBSERVED.

reference.note: largest surface of fresh water in the world
